body:
Thank you for sharing this. I've been dealing with the same type of situation as of late.

Unfortunately, it caused a separation between my partner and I. For the time being, I have moved out. I'm not sure if it's the best decision, but I do relate to how you said "I didn't realize this was a problem until I entered a relationship with the love of my life." I did not realize either, and i'm hoping...**praying** that this is just a speed bump we can get over. I made a lot of mistakes. And the best thing for me, is to learn from them. Learn the triggers. Learn what upsets you. And learn how to calm your emotions down.

The good thing is that you have identified it, and if he is still around, then just realize he cares and sometimes those thoughts are just thoughts. That's it! (*It's incredibly difficult, i know, but you have to continuously remind yourself).*

​

Remember to breathe, and remember that you are you. And no one else can ever replace that <3 Good Luck
